text:
elaine: Heads-up: Zenith POC just reported streaming breaks during live demo prep. They see EventSource disconnects and half-JSON payloads that choke their parser. Demo in 3pm PT. Can we triage fast?

viktor: Need request-id and whether they're behind a CDN. Also: SDK or native EventSource?

elaine: Request-id rwd-ah-7702. They're on an internal Android WebView with a polyfill. They pasted: `data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"Sure, here is t` then cut. JSON.parse fails.

jamie: Quick checklist: 1) Have them run `curl -N` to see raw SSE, 2) tell them to buffer event lines until blank-line delimiter, 3) check any nginx or LB timeouts.

sre-lee: Infra looked up rwd-ah-7702: connection lasted ~12s then FIN. No token or quota issues. Suggest enabling heartbeat pings (15s) on their route while they patch client. We can flip a canary.

viktor: Share this tiny client fix (pseudo):
```
let acc=''; source.onmessage = e => { acc += e.data + '\n'; if(acc.endsWith('\n\n')){ try{ const payload = acc.replace(/(^data:\s*)/gm,'').trim(); acc=''; const obj = JSON.parse(payload); onEvent(obj); }catch(e){ console.warn('partial event'); } } };
```

jamie: If they use nginx, this snippet helps: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_read_timeout 3600s; chunked_transfer_encoding on;`. Also check any Cloudflare/Front door idle timeouts.

sre-lee: deploy-bot: will enable heartbeat-canary for /v1/stream/chat at 10% traffic. Monitor for increased churn.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-04-11T14:10Z: heartbeat-canary enabled (10%).

elaine: Sales note: Zenith asked about private deployment to avoid CDN quirks. Explain that private can reduce intermediaries but requires infra config and procurement time.

viktor: Action items: collect raw first-8KB of failing stream (they can base64 it), verify client UA and proxy chain, and try fetch-stream fallback.

elaine: I'll relay steps to Zenith and ask for raw bytes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
